newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch closing debt market report.
newsitem.headline: Dutch closing debt market report.

text.p: Dutch bonds closed an uneventful session with moderate losses but above session lows as the market waited for Tuesday's announcement of a new bund issue and a welter of German and U.S. economic data later this week.
Details of a new Dutch state bond issue, or re-opening of an earlier issue, are due to be announced on Friday January 17.
The Dutch government also announced last week that it had placed six billion guilders worth of bonds with the Finance Ministry's debt agency for gradual sale into the market.
It placed equal amounts of the 7.5 pct bond due January 2023 and the nine percent bond due January 2001 with the agency.
